name: specfit
description: 스펙핏 — AI·개발 작업용 하드웨어를 스펙 기준으로 선별하는 정적 사이트

scripts.serve: node --run build && node -e "import('node:http').then(async h=>{const {readFile}=await import('node:fs/promises');const {extname,join}=await import('node:path');const t={'.html':'text/html','.css':'text/css','.js':'text/javascript','.json':'application/json','.svg':'image/svg+xml','.xml':'application/xml','.txt':'text/plain'};h.createServer(async(q,s)=>{let p=q.url.split('?')[0];if(p.endsWith('/'))p+='index.html';try{const b=await readFile(join(process.cwd(),decodeURIComponent(p)));s.writeHead(200,{'content-type':t[extname(p)]||'application/octet-stream'});s.end(b)}catch{s.writeHead(404);s.end('404')}}).listen(4173,()=>console.log('http://localhost:4173'))})"
